verdict.rationale: Orama lets you control data location through self-hosting rather than a managed region picker. Orama Cloud offers on-premise deployment of the context server on your own infrastructure, and the open-source library runs inside your own application, so data stays wherever you deploy it. Missing for 10: region selection for managed Orama Cloud, explicit data-residency guarantees or compliance documentation, and independent corroboration of the on-premise option.
